Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

standby 0.2.2

Bug Fixes

  • Loaders now handle valid HTML output ids such as a.b, a:b and 1plot. The Shiny handlers use the event target instead of building a CSS selector from the id, and MicroTip uses document.getElementById() (H01).
  • vizLoad(type = "dots") now honours color: the pulsating keyframes read per-widget custom properties instead of hard-coded colours (H02).
  • spinkit() colours no longer bleed between widgets of the same type. The pseudo-element rules are scoped to the widget id (H03).
  • threeDots() now sets --primary-color on each widget, so animations drawn with box-shadow use the requested colour (H04).
  • Colour names are normalised to their R colour values before being emitted ("green" is #00FF00, "gray50" is #7F7F7F), so the main colour and the derived shades share one hue and R-only names are no longer silently ignored by the browser (H05).
  • The color validator accepts the documented CSS colour grammar again: CSS-only keywords (rebeccapurple), signed/negative hues, hue units and modern space/slash rgb()/hsl() syntax are accepted, while stylesheet and HTML delimiters are still rejected (H06).
  • Spinner shades preserve the requested alpha, so a fully transparent colour stays transparent and rgba(..., 0.5) produces shades at half strength (H07).
  • Spinner shade channels are rounded half-up like CSS, so rgb(30%,0%,0%) derives shades from 77 rather than 76 (H08).
  • notify() no longer renders the literal text null for its documented default text = NULL, or for title = NULL (H09).
  • notify() renders Shiny tags supplied as title/text to HTML and marks only those as trusted, instead of displaying [object Object] (H10).
  • notify(delay = "infinity") (and delay = Inf) keeps the notice open until it is closed manually, as documented (H11).
  • notify(translucent = TRUE) now has a defined see-through appearance (H12).
  • microTip() removes data-microtip-size when size is NULL/"fit", so updating a tooltip back to the default size no longer keeps the old size (H13).
  • bootBox(close_on_escape = FALSE) keeps the dialog open when Escape is pressed. The bridge uses bootbox.dialog() with an explicit OK button instead of bootbox.alert(), which overwrote the Escape policy (H14).
  • toast() cover images are visible by default: image_width defaults to the documented "50px" and numeric or unit-bearing widths are handled consistently (H15).
  • Toast title/message font sizes and line heights honour their own values, including unit-bearing input and an unset title_size (H16).
  • toast(display_mode = ...) implements the documented behaviour: 0 waits for the current toast to close, 1 replaces the displayed toast(s), and the library’s replace-an-identical-toast mode is now documented as 2 (H17).
  • previewSpinners("vizload") renders the documented vizload preview instead of an empty container; both preview helpers validate their argument (H18).
  • Loading the CSS Loaders dependency no longer hides Single Element CSS Spinners: CSS Loaders’ base .loader rules are scoped to its own widget (H19).
  • alertify_alert(type = ...) now has a defined effect: the dialog gets a type class and a type-specific accent border and header colour (M04).

Documentation

  • Colour arguments document that names follow R’s colors(), and that CSS colour names are also accepted.
  • use*() helpers and loader constructors document their return values instead of None (L03).
  • Preview messages and the vignette refer to standby rather than buzz (L02).
  • Removed the unavailable tinyverse status badge from the README (L01).

Internal

  • Maintainer email updated to aravindhebbali@rsquaredacademy.com (M01).
  • testthat minimum raised to 3.1.5, matching the expectations used by the tests (M03).
  • cran-comments.md describes this release and its check results (M02).

standby 0.2.1

Bug Fixes

  • Validate color in threeDots(), spinkit(), spinners(), and vizLoad() to prevent HTML/CSS injection.
  • Validate type in spinners() against supported types 1 to 8, giving a clear error naming the allowed values.
  • Accept rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() colours for spinners() types 5 and 8, including when generating shade colours.
  • Accept valid rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() colours with a leading-dot alpha value (for example rgba(0,0,0,.5)).
  • Validate type in vizLoad() against documented supported types.
  • Scope generated CSS to individual widget instances in spinners() and vizLoad() to prevent color bleeding across loaders of the same type.
  • Correct documentation for alertify_alert() defaults (auto_reset, maximizable, modal, movable, move_bounded, and overflow) to match function behavior.
  • Fix broken alerts and notifications example in README.
  • Remove stray console.log() statement in MicroTip JavaScript handler.
  • Generate unique IDs per call in threeDots() and loaders(), and scope threeDots() CSS to its own ID to avoid collisions across multiple instances and within Shiny modules.
  • Validate animation type in threeDots() and loaders() using match.arg().
  • Validate size per type in vizLoad() against supported combinations and document supported sizes.
  • Replace the lvl-5 offset class with lv-mid centering for small and tiny sizes in vizLoad().
  • Apply color to vizLoad(type = "dots") loaders.
  • Fix AlertifyJS JavaScript bridge property names for maximizable and resizable, and wire the label setting.
  • Include type in the custom message payload sent by toast().
  • Avoid adding animation classes in bootBox() when class = NULL.
  • Correct documented defaults for toast() position and notify() title and text to match function arguments.
